sources.title: Z-Image-Lora: Text-to-Image model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview Z-Image-Lora is a collection of LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) modules trained by nphSi to add character likenesses to the Z-Image base checkpoint. The model includes over 200 character LoRAs covering celebrities, fictional characters, and public figures, each trained at 1MP resolution using OneTrainer on publicly available internet images. sources.title: Z-Image-Art - v2.0 | ZImage LoRA | Civitai
sources.snippet: Trained on about 75+ random art images, including anime, digital art, and other styles I found on Pinterest. I recommend setting the strength to 0.7 as increasing it further would give anatomical artifacts. A LoRA strength between 0.5 and 0.7 is a good range. This LoRA also works well as an enhancer for Z images, especially at low strengths.
